title: Feature engineering: encoding, scaling, dates and text

videos.script: A model only sees the columns it is given. {{columns}} A tree can find a cliff in a column on its own. A line cannot. {{cliff}} This lesson hands a simple model the shapes it cannot find, and measures what each one is worth. {{measure}} First, looking. A rating below three point six, three skips, three weeks without the app. {{shapes}} Seven short columns lift the logistic regression level with gradient boosting. {{past}} Then gaps, and why a missing value can be information. {{gaps}} Categories, and what to do with a plan that did not exist yesterday. {{categories}} The hour of the day, four ways. {{hours}} And text, counted in words and in pairs. {{text}} Not every idea pays. By the end, you add a feature the way you test a model: you measure it. {{end}}
